Events.EventTitle: One Vision of Queen featuring Marc Martel
Events.Description: When Hollywood needed someone to help bring Freddie Mercury's voice to life in the Oscar-winning film "Bohemian Rhapsody," they turned to Marc Martel. Experience the music of QUEEN live in concert like never before, including iconic hits "Bohemian Rhapsody," "We Will Rock You," and "Somebody to Love" in this high-energy concert celebration.

Hop on the Magic School Bus for a ride through the solar system in this new musical adaptation based on the original book series published by Scholastic. When the class gets lost on the way to the planetarium, Ms. Frizzle saves the day by blasting into outer space for an epic interplanetary field trip!

Get ready to be dazzled, enchanted, and filled with holiday cheer as you witness the incredible talents of world-class entertainers performing jaw-dropping acrobatics and amazing stunts, all set to your favorite holiday music. Embrace the holiday spirit with A Magical Cirque Christmas, an evening of nostalgia, charm, and awe-inspiring performances for all ages. Celebrate the magic of the season with the entire family!

Events.EventTitle: The Swingles: Together for the Holidays
Events.Description: This holiday season, the British five-time GRAMMY(R)-winning a cappella group The Swingles presents a feast of musical comfort and joy, with classic carols and festive favorites that evoke fireside singalongs, icebound worlds, and blankets of snow. Wrap yourself in the warm vocal magic of The Swingles for a special night that proves there's no place like the Lied Center for the holidays.

A mother. A daughter. 3 possible dads. 
And a trip down the aisleyou'll never forget! 

Set on a Greek island paradise where the sun always shines, a tale of love, friendship, and identity is beautifully told through the timeless hits of ABBA. On the eve of her wedding, a daughter's quest to discover the father she's never known brings three men from her mother's past back to the island they last visited decades ago.  

For over 25 years, people all around the world have fallen in love with the characters, the story, and the music that make MAMMA MIA! the ultimate feel-good show.

A mansion. A murder. A mystery. 

Murder and blackmail are on the menu when six mysterious guests assemble at Boddy Manor for a night they'll never forget! Was it Mrs. Peacock in the study with the knife? Or was it Colonel Mustard in the library with the wrench? Based on the fan-favorite 1985 Paramount Pictures movie and inspired by the classic Hasbro board game, Clue is the ultimate whodunit that will leave you dying of laughter and keep you guessing until the final twist.

Events.EventTitle: Metro Jazz Quintet: Hot Latin Nights
Events.Description:
HOT LATIN NIGHTS
The Music of Antonio Carlos Jobim, Dizzy Gillespie, Chick Corea and more!

Following three consecutive sold-out seasons, Metro Jazz returns to the Lied's Johnny Carson Theater with an all-new season of intimate, club-style performances. Featuring Nebraska's finest jazz musicians, each program explores a different theme performed in a candlelit setting with table seating and cocktails. It's the perfect way to experience live jazz up close and unforgettable.

Bizet's Carmen has seen countless interpretations over the past 150 years, but never one like this. Acclaimed choreographer Gustavo Ramrez Sansano brings this full-length ballet to the stage, inspired by tauromaquia - the art of bullfighting - breathing a modern life into this legendary character. Highly original and full of explosive movement that leaves you breathless, CARMEN.maquiais a bold reimagining of this tragic tale presented by Ballet Hispnico New York, the nation's leading Hispanic/Latin dance company.

Events.EventTitle: The Music of Billy Joel and Elton John starring Michael Cavanaugh
Events.Description: Handpicked by Billy Joel to play the leading role in Joel's Broadway show featuring his greatest hits, Micheal Cavanaugh starred in over 1,200 performances of the Broadway show Movin' Out earning him a Tony Award(R) nomination for his performance as Billy Joel. The Music of Billy Joel and Elton John features the greatest hits of these two great rock piano legends with songs, including: "Piano Man," "Rocket Man," "Bennie and the Jets," "Movin' Out," "I'm Still Standing," "My Life," and many more.

Featured at almost every major music festival including Coachella, Bonnaroo, Lollapalooza, and Newport Jazz, Trombone Shorty regularly headlines the New Orleans Jazz Festival and makes his debut Lied Center performance this season! A powerhouse entertainer, he has toured with everyone from Maroon 5 to the Red Hot Chili Peppers and collaborated across genres with Pharrell, Bruno Mars, Mark Ronson, Foo Fighters, Zac Brown and Ringo Starr. This New Orleans ambassador has performed everywhere from the White House and GRAMMY(R) awards to Madison Square Garden and the 2025 Super Bowl.  Enjoy this must-see concert straight from the heart of New Orleans!

"Indeed, if there is such a thing as perfection in music, KOD comes as near to it as any group in the world." - The Boston Globe 

For the first time in 25 years, the internationally acclaimed taiko sensation Kod returns to the Lied Center! With a breathtaking exploration of rhythm, movement, and light, Kod combines centuries-old taiko drumming traditions with striking theatricality, creating a performance that is deeply immersive, powerful, and meditative. Experience the thunderous energy and precision of one of the world's premier percussion ensembles.

GRAMMY(R) award-winning Orpheus Chamber Orchestra returns to the Lied with British virtuoso pianist Isata Kanneh-Mason for an evening of elegance and vitality. The program pairs classical favorites by Mozart and Haydn with selections from Handel's Water Music Suite and a newly commissioned work by Katie Jenkins, showcasing Orpheus' trademark conductor-less precision and collaborative spirit.

Events.EventTitle: Chicka Chicka Boom Boom: The Musical
Events.Description: The beloved children's storybook bursts onto the stage in a bright, musical, and joy-filled celebration of letters, words, and imagination. With infectious rhythms, dazzling puppets, and lively dancing, this high-energy production transforms the beloved story into a whirlwind of color, creativity, and fun. Amid the chaos,Littlez struggles to find its place, always arriving last and left behind. With the help of the Big Letters and a heartwarming finale, z learns that everyone has value and a place to belong.

Maizy and Beau are getting hitched, when the corn that protects their small community starts to die. The town needs answers. But who will dare to venture beyond the borders of Cob County? 

Including the knockout songs 'Woman of the World', 'Somebody Will' and 'Independently Owned', this Broadway hit about an unlikely hero, an unscrupulous con artist, and a battle for the heart and soil of a small town, is not to be missed. 

SHUCKED is recommended for ages 10+. SHUCKED contains adult themes, moments of adult language and a harvest of corny innuendo.

Relive the magic of "Twilight" with Twilight In Concert! A stunning 12-piece ensemble will perform the unforgettable film score live, synchronized with the movie on a full-size cinema screen. Surrounded by the glow of over a thousand candles, this cinematic live-to-film concert experience will take you back to Forks like never before. Don't miss this extraordinary night of music and romance. 

This film is rated PG-13 by the Motion Picture Association of America.

Emmet Cohen is widely regarded as a leading jazz pianist of his generation and makes his Lied Center debut this season! A virtuoso musician, producer, and bandleader, Cohen has released 12 albums and is the creative force behind Live From Emmet's Place, a landmark series comprising over 140 two-hour livestream performances featuring hundreds of musicians spanning generations and reaching more than 100 million views worldwide. Cohen was named DownBeat Readers Poll Pianist of the Year (2025) and, in 2023, received both Pianist of the Year and Livestream Producer of the Year honors from the Jazz Journalists Association.

"Many wonders await audiences in this gorgeously imaginative Broadway musical." - The New York Times    

The critically acclaimed bestselling novel comes to "thrilling, dazzling" life (Time Out New York) in a unique, spectacle-filled new musical! Hailed as a Critic's Pick, The New York Times calls it "stunning, emotional, heart-filled and gorgeously imaginative."    

After losing what matters most, a young man jumps a moving train unsure of where the road will take him and finds a new home with the remarkable crew of a traveling circus, and a life-and love-beyond his wildest dreams. Seen through the eyes of his older self, his adventure becomes a poignant reminder that if you choose the ride, life can begin again at any age.    

So, step right up to the "spellbinding entertainment" (Variety) at WATER FOR ELEPHANTS, "the best new musical on Broadway" (Theatermania).

Recommended for ages 8 and up.  
Smoke, haze and gunshot sound effects are used in this production.

Riverdance has captured the hearts of millions. The GRAMMY(R)  award-winning music and the infectious energy of its breathtaking performances has left audiences in awe and established Riverdance as a global cultural sensation. Celebrating its incredible 30th year milestone, Riverdance 30 - The New Generation rejuvenates the much-loved original show with new innovative choreography, costumes, and state of the art lighting, projection and motion graphics. And for the first time, Riverdance welcomes "The New Generation" of performers, all of whom were not born when the show began 30 years ago. Experience a unique and mesmerizing show that blends the traditional and the contemporary, showcasing the skill and passion of the world-class dancers, musicians, and singers in the Riverdance ensemble.

Composed by Bill Whelan.
Produced by Moya Doherty.
Directed by John McColgan.
www.riverdance.com

It's classical music like you've never seen it before! In Piano Battle, virtuoso pianists Andreas Kern and Paul Cibis go head-to-head in a thrilling, interactive competition where the audience decides the winner of each round. Blending dazzling technique with humor and showmanship, this high-energy performance transforms a traditional recital into an unforgettable musical showdown. Who performs it best? You decide!

Praised as "the most astounding pianist of our age" by London's The Times, GRAMMY(R) Award-winning pianist Daniil Trifonov makes his Lied Center debut with a program showcasing extraordinary range. Handel's Suite No. 5 in E Major ("The Harmonious Blacksmith") opens the concert followed by Stravinsky's sole piano sonata and Schubert's beloved "Wanderer Fantasy," a powerful musical depiction of a stranger's search for meaning and happiness in a strange land. Trifonov's stylistic exploration continues on the program's second half featuring Brazilian, Argentine, and Dominican composers as well as his own original Tango! Combining consummate technique with rare sensitivity and depth, Trifonov's performances are a perpetual source of wonder to audiences and critics alike.

"He is Amazing! I'm Speechless" - Jimmy Fallon, The Tonight Show 

"Showmanship, creativity, deception! Everything about it is Perfect." - Penn Jillette, Penn & Teller 

You've seen him on "America's Got Talent," "Jimmy Fallon," "Masters of Illusion", and "Penn & Teller: Fool Us!" Do not miss Illusionist Leon Etienne's jaw-dropping, critically acclaimed hit show Magic Rocks! Witness the world's best illusions in this immersive experience making its Lied Center debut!

Emmy Award(R)-winning Actor Richard Thomasbrings to life "the nation's one true comic genius" (The New York Times) inMark Twain Tonight! Join the millions who have cheered for the legendary one-man show, bursting with Twain's "uproariously funny" and "pungently wise" (Time magazine) humor. Most recently seen on Broadway in"Our Town" and on tour (including at the Lied!) as Atticus Finch in"To Kill a Mockingbird," and beloved to generations as John-Boy Walton,Richard Thomasis the first and only actor authorized to performMark Twain Tonight!since the original.

A jaw-dropping spectacle, Italy's NoGravity plays with perspective, reflection, and distortion in its Lied Center premiere performance! On stage, the dancers move, fly in the air, and create unreal figures as if freed from gravitation - blending dance, illusion, and visual storytelling. NoGravity is celebrated for their works based on Dante's "Divine Comedy" creating a dreamlike visual world. This innovative production transforms the stage into a dreamlike landscape of floating movement and striking imagery. creating a unique theatrical experience challenging the boundaries of dance.

The unforgettable story of passion, unstoppable ambition, and the dawn of a new nation, seen by more than 28 million people around the world.

HAMILTON is the epic saga that follows the rise of Founding Father Alexander Hamilton as he fights for honor, love, and a legacy that would shape the course of a nation. Based on Ron Chernow's acclaimed biography and set to a score that blends hip-hop, jazz, R&B, and Broadway, HAMILTON has had a profound impact on culture, politics, and education. HAMILTON features book, music, and lyrics by Lin-Manuel Miranda, direction by Thomas Kail, choreography by Andy Blankenbuehler, and musical supervision and orchestrations by Alex Lacamoire. In addition to its 11 Tony Awards(R), it has won Grammy(R) and Olivier Awards, and the Pulitzer Prize for Drama.

HAMILTON is the epic saga that follows the rise of Founding Father Alexander Hamilton as he fights for honor, love, and a legacy that would shape the course of a nation. Based on Ron Chernow's acclaimed biography and set to a score that blends hip-hop, jazz, R&B, and Broadway, HAMILTON has had a profound impact on culture, politics, and education. HAMILTON features book, music, and lyrics by Lin-Manuel Miranda, direction by Thomas Kail, choreography by Andy Blankenbuehler, and musical supervision and orchestrations by Alex Lacamoire. In addition to its 11 Tony Awards(R), it has won Grammy(R) and Olivier Awards, and the Pulitzer Prize for Drama.
